# MDD Sim Gateway v1.6.1

## 中文

### 0. 重要更新说明

- v1.6.0 及更早版本生成的支持包不会被追溯补全；其中可能没有保留最后一次自动恢复失败的
  决策记录。分享任何支持包前仍应人工检查脱敏结果。

### 1. v1.6.1 补丁更新

- 修复 [Issue #30](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/30)：大疆/Quectel 模块的桥接元数据一次
  临时 IMEI 读取失败会覆盖已验证的硬件身份，导致约数小时后的健康恢复被
  `hardware_imei_required` 拦住。现在不完整刷新会在同一桥进程内保留已验证 IMEI；当实时桥
  无法验证身份时，不再复用线路保存的 modem IMEI，避免无 USB 序列号的模块在同一端口被替换后
  借用旧模块身份。
- 针对重新打开的 [Issue #21](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/21)，支持包新增独立、有界的
  恢复决策记录，可区分“已调度、无卡阻断、IMEI 门禁失败、用户取消、恢复成功”；只写
  枚举原因和布尔状态，不写异常自由文本、IMEI、ICCID 或设备路径。
- 支持包现在显示每个日志的原始/收录行数、截断状态和修改时间，JSONL 还显示首末
  事件时间；IKE 分段同时保留开头和结尾。压缩包硬限 10 MiB，超限时按固定优先级
  省略普通日志，manifest 会明确标注；故障快照和恢复决策优先保留。无上限增长的通话
  事件文件只解析最后 20,000 行，并在 manifest 标出未扫描的前缀行数。

### 2. 当前大版本更新

- v1.6 系列增加离线来电保持与登录后全局接听，通知按事件自定义，eSIM 切换以卡片实况为准，
  并改进了国家出口兼容性、加载状态与多设备能力隔离。

本补丁为 Engine 事件日志增加时间戳，发布时需要重新构建 Control 与 Engine 资产。

---

## English

### 0. Important update notes

- Support bundles created by v1.6.0 and earlier are not retroactively extended and may not retain
  the decision behind the final automatic-recovery failure. Continue to review every bundle for
  redaction before sharing it.

### 1. v1.6.1 patch update

- Fixed [Issue #30](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/30): one temporary IMEI read
  failure during a DJI/Quectel bridge metadata refresh could erase the verified hardware identity,
  so a health rebuild hours later stopped at `hardware_imei_required`. Incomplete refreshes now
  retain the verified IMEI within the same bridge process. Recovery no longer reuses a line-saved
  modem IMEI when the live bridge cannot verify it, preventing a serial-less replacement module in
  the same USB port from borrowing its predecessor's identity.
- For the reopened [Issue #21](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/21), support bundles
  now carry a separate bounded recovery-decision log that distinguishes scheduled, no-card blocked,
  IMEI-gate failed, operator-cancelled, and successful recovery. It stores only enumerated reasons
  and boolean state, never free-form exception text, IMEI, ICCID, or device paths.
- Bundles now report each log's raw/included line counts, truncation and modification time, plus
  first/last event times for JSONL. IKE segments retain both their beginning and end. A hard 10 MiB
  archive ceiling omits ordinary logs in deterministic priority order and records each omission in
  the manifest, preserving failure snapshots and recovery decisions first. Unbounded call-event
  files are parsed only across their latest 20,000 lines, with any unscanned prefix reported.

### 2. Current major release

- The v1.6 series adds offline incoming-call holding with global pickup after sign-in, per-event
  notification templates, live-card-authoritative eSIM switching, and improved country-exit
  compatibility, loading states, and multi-device capability isolation.

This patch timestamps Engine event records, so both Control and Engine assets must be rebuilt.
